content: {"question":"If I move from GitLab Canada Corp to GitLab LTD (UK), how does my sick leave entitlement change in terms of paid days and eligibility for statutory benefits?","answer":"In Canada you receive 10 paid sick days per year (with 3 days after the first month) and can get up to 25 additional paid days for extended illness, while in the UK you are eligible for Statutory Sick Pay from day one for up to 28 weeks, with no earnings threshold.","evidence_a":"- **Annual Allowance**: 10 days per year (3 days available after first month of employment)","evidence_b":"- All team members are eligible for SSP from their first day of employment. The previous Lower Earnings Limit (requiring team members to earn at least GBP 125 per week to qualify) is abolished."}
